latestVersion.changelog:
Free Video Generation AI v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Generate AI-powered videos from text prompts, supporting MP4, MOV, WebM, GIF (up to 500MB).
- Automated cloud setup with anonymous session and free credits for new users.
- Supports video editing features: overlays, BGM, aspect ratio, and more, via natural language prompts.
- Seamless cloud processing: submit prompts, manage session state, export videos, and track credits.
- Error handling for token/session issues, file limits, and rate limits with helpful user feedback.
- Detailed usage guidance and instant feedback messages throughout the workflow.
